sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Lets short movies play while Developer options are turned on, instead of asking to turn them off.

Stops the analytics and crash reporting SDKs (AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Google Tag Manager, comScore and Facebook events) from collecting data. CleverTap stays for push and popups, without the advertising ID.
Removes the Google ad banners from the home, article, quiz, event and live screens, and the promo popups.
Removes the "+" button (write news, start a live stream) from the middle of the navigation bar. The switch is in Fakh Patches.
Adds switches to hide the Nonton, IDN Live, Berita and Quiz tabs in Fakh Patches.
Removes the "Beli Paket" banner from the profile, since packages cannot be bought in a patched app. The switch is in Fakh Patches.
Opens connect.idn.media/my-account/gold in the browser instead of the in-app Gold top up.
Adds a switch to stop the video previews and the automatic sliding of the home banners in Fakh Patches.
